name: excrusio
description: Manage the Excrusio travel CMS (tours, hotels, transfers, flights, blog, media, bookings, reviews, settings) from Claude Code, limited to your own dashboard role via a personal access token.

EXCRUSIO_API_URL.title: Excrusio API URL
EXCRUSIO_API_URL.description: Base URL of your Excrusio dashboard (e.g. https://dashboard.example.com). https required except localhost.

EXCRUSIO_TOKEN.title: Personal access token
EXCRUSIO_TOKEN.description: Personal access token created in Dashboard > Settings > Integrations > API Tokens (starts with excr_pat_).

EXCRUSIO_UPLOAD_ROOT.title: Upload root directory
EXCRUSIO_UPLOAD_ROOT.description: Optional. Directory that media_upload may read files from (default: the directory Claude Code was started in).
